params.topic: Bundesliga near-eight-season row-level historical fixture and bookmaker odds supplement for incremental Qimen shadow research
questions: For Bundesliga seasons 2018-19 through 2025-26, collect or assess row-level public sources for every match using exact identity keys season, match_date, home_team, away_team, including 90-minute result and home/away goals.

For each match, collect separate Bet365, Pinnacle, and William Hill 1X2 fields when directly evidenced, plus total-goals/OU fields where available. If a page contains a bookmaker label resembling Belle or another alias, report the exact displayed label and do not map it silently.

Keep opening, pre-closing, closing, and historical-tick semantics separate. If true opening is unavailable, return pre-closing and/or closing as separate fields with O_PRE_CLOSE or O_CLOSE semantics; never rename them opening.

Return structured row-level data or a machine-readable coverage manifest with source_url, final_url, fetched_at, source_hash when possible, bookmaker, market, field semantics, and evidence notes. Do not infer Qimen palace, Q/F/G/I tokens, model direction, or predictions from scores, standings, odds, or prose.

Report season-by-season audit totals: expected matches, discovered, identity-matched, complete, partial, unavailable, conflicts, and unresolved_queue. Explicitly separate the five currently available local seasons from the three seasons missing in the local SQ database.

Assess whether the returned data is suitable for an incremental O_INTERVAL odds structure screen. If true opening is unavailable, state the exact safe fallback as pre-closing-to-closing interval and identify which seasons/bookmakers/markets remain unavailable.
